wa_castle_peak_pasayten_scramble.trailhead_note: WTA Castle Peak page (coords 48.9822,-120.8607) says it can be reached from the north (provincial park), the PCT on the west, or Freezeout Creek on the east; no distance. Castle Pass trail (#749) runs from the PCT at Castle Pass west to the Lightning Creek Trail junction in Ross Lake NRA. Trail is closed due to the Ptarmigan Fire (WTA note dated 9.14.26). Whether the 18.9 mi starts at Ross Lake or the PCT is not stated; the PCT/Harts Pass end and Ross Lake end are both candidates, so it is not safe to assign it to our Ross Dam pin.

other_facts.fact: Castle Pass trail not maintained by the Forest Service since 2006, many downed trees, impassable to stock
Castle Peak highest point 8,306 ft per WTA; Peakbagger lists 8348 ft
Castle Pass trail: Wilderness permit self-issue at trailhead, no fee; Ross Lake access no parking fee; NW Forest Pass for Pasayten parking
